SILT#00051: If you need to dynamically create component themselves in Svelte 5 (like having a list of components for each step of a stepper), then you just can use it directly without `<svelte:component>`, with one small adjustment to make sure it is Pascal case. See this answer on StackOverflow: <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/65656481/how-to-dynamically-render-components-in-svelte>
